title: Explosive Grenade Skill Guide — Bounce, Fuse, Cooldown and Detonation
summary: Explosive Grenade is a thrown / crossbow grenade skill: it bounces after throwing, explodes after a fuse timer dealing fire area damage and leaving an igniting ground. This guide covers bounce and fuse, Cooldown charges, Detonator tag synergy with other skills, 80% phys-to-fire, Heat source and value, why the landing is unstable, and Mapping vs Boss configuration differences.
description: Deep Explosive Grenade guide: bounce and fuse, Cooldown charges, Detonator detonation synergy, 80% phys-to-fire, Heat source and value, landing stability, Adhesive / Short Fuse / Payload tradeoffs, Mapping vs Boss config, and real community issues with direct answers.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Overview: What Explosive Grenade Does
paragraphs: Explosive Grenade is a grenade-type skill (common in the Crossbow system): you throw a grenade that bounces along the ground, and after a fuse timer it explodes dealing fire area damage and leaving an igniting (ignite) ground that keeps burning. The most misunderstood part is players thinking 'it explodes immediately on throw' — actually the landing point and detonation timing are key.

It converts 80% of physical damage to fire, so the core value comes from fire damage, ignite and area, not physical direct hit. It also carries the Detonator tag: other skills (like Fragmentation Rounds) can detonate it early, actively controlling the explosion timing.

Because it is a Cooldown / charges-driven skill, it shares rhythm with the crossbow Heat system and ammo skills. Understanding the timeline 'bounce → fuse → explode → ignite ground' turns it from 'random throws that miss' into a reliable AoE and sustained Burn source.
bullets: Essence: grenade attack + bounce + fuse detonation + fire AoE + ignite ground.
80% phys-to-fire: value from fire damage, ignite and area.
Detonator tag: can be pre-detonated by Fragmentation Rounds etc.
Cooldown / charges-driven, shares rhythm with crossbow Heat system.

sections.title: Core Mechanics: Bounce, Fuse, Cooldown and Heat
paragraphs: Bounce and fuse: after thrown the grenade bounces along terrain and only explodes after a fixed fuse timer. This means both the 'landing point' and the 'detonation moment' can be altered by bouncing — which is the root cause of newbies feeling 'it always bounces out of the boss area'. Predicting the landing and using a short fuse or proactive detonation is far more effective than blind throwing.

Cooldown / charges: Explosive Grenade usually has charges and a cooldown, not infinite throws. Treat it as a resource to periodically lay AoE / Burn, not mindless spam. Plan how many to lay when charges are full.

Detonator synergy: grenades with the Detonator tag can be pre-detonated by specific skills (like Fragmentation Rounds). Proactive detonation lets you explode precisely when monsters cluster or during a boss break window, instead of waiting for the natural fuse. This is the key to turning Grenade from 'passive wait' into 'controlled burst'.

80% phys-to-fire and Heat: most damage converts to fire, so stacking fire damage / fire penetration is more effective than physical. The crossbow Heat system accumulates heat with some skills; once heat reaches a threshold it may grant extra fire damage or overload effects — Heat is a buff source, not a mandatory burden, but managing it well keeps the extra fire damage triggering steadily.
bullets: Bounce changes landing, fuse decides explosion moment; predict the landing.
Has charges / Cooldown, manage as a periodic resource.
Detonator: proactively detonate with Fragmentation Rounds to control timing.
Heat is a buff (extra fire damage), not a mandatory burden, but manage it.
0.5.1 fixed a Quality projectile-related bug; old video projectile behaviour may be outdated.

sections.title: Role and Differences Across Builds
paragraphs: Witchhunter (Crossbow): the most typical Explosive Grenade carrier. Witchhunter's ascendancy emphasises damage amp and utility tools against 'marked / executed' enemies, pairing with the crossbow detonation and Heat systems to make Grenade a reliable AoE and Burn source. In 0.5 Witchhunter is strong, and Grenade is its clear and burn-laying mainstay.

Mapping vs Boss difference: while mapping you can throw several, use bounce to cover packs, and pair Magnified Area for large ignite coverage; on boss the unstable landing is the main pain point — switch to a short fuse or proactive detonation (Detonator) to explode precisely in the break window instead of waiting for the natural fuse.

Relationship with Fragmentation Rounds: skills like Fragmentation can pre-detonate grenades, acting as the Grenade playstyle's 'detonator'. Whether you treat Grenade as 'area-laying' or 'a bomb to be detonated' depends on whether you plug into this detonation chain.
bullets: Witchhunter: Grenade is clear and burn-laying mainstay, with Heat / detonation.
Clear: multiple + bounce + large ignite; Boss: short fuse / proactive detonation.
Fragmentation Rounds is Grenade's detonator, deciding the playstyle shape.

sections.title: Common Mistakes: Why It Misses and Damage Fluctuates
paragraphs: Landing always bounces out of boss area: grenades bounce, blind throws at the boss's feet will bounce away. Predict the bounce, or switch to a short fuse / proactive detonation to explode precisely in the cluster window.

Damage suddenly much higher: usually Heat hitting the threshold triggers extra fire damage, or you just detonated with Detonator in a break window. Understand this is mechanic, not random, to reproduce it stably.
Is Heat mandatory or optional: Heat is a buff source (extra fire damage / overload), not a burden; but you do need to manage it to trigger steadily. Don't sacrifice key defenses for Heat.

Is Payload worth the longer Cooldown: Payload-type supports extend the effect but lengthen the cooldown; whether it's worth it depends on whether you lean sustained area-laying or burst — lean sustained on clear, weigh on burst boss.
Can multiple hits hit the same target: yes, but limited by charges / Cooldown; rather than stacking count, use proactive detonation to fully land a single grenade's damage on a key target.
bullets: Problem: can't hit boss. Direct answer: predict bounce, short fuse or proactive detonation.
Problem: fluctuating damage. Direct answer: Heat threshold or break-window detonation, mechanic not random.
Problem: must I manage Heat. Direct answer: it's a buff not a burden, but manage it.
Problem: is Payload worth it. Direct answer: lean sustained on clear, weigh on burst boss.

items.question: Why does the grenade always bounce away and miss?
answer: After thrown the grenade bounces along terrain, its landing altered by bouncing.
Predict the landing, or switch to a short fuse / proactive detonation (Detonator) to control the explosion position.

items.question: Is Heat mandatory to stack?
answer: Heat is a buff source (extra fire damage / overload), not a burden.
But it needs management to trigger steadily; don't sacrifice defense for Heat.

items.question: How do I proactively detonate the grenade?
answer: Explosive Grenade carries the Detonator tag, pre-detonatable by skills like Fragmentation Rounds.
After plugging into the detonation chain, you can explode precisely in the break window instead of waiting for the fuse.

items.question: How should I use grenades in boss fights?
answer: Boss landing is unstable; use short fuse or proactive detonation to explode in the cluster / break window.
Rather than stacking count, fully land a single grenade's damage on the key target.
